I've tried getting this answered before but will ask again…They have stated time and time again that the card game will have a release at the end of its run containing all the promos ever released along the way.I'm trying to learn if Tactics will have that same thing happen.  Will there be a release of all tactis promos at the end of the tactics run?Also, if they do, will it include alternate promo panels we are now seeing be released.  

Short answer: Yes

Long answer: The promo power cards in Tactics are going to be much easier to get a hold of than the promo character cards for SotM. Have you looked at the online store? I'll copy and paste some info for you

Sentinel Tactics: The Flame of Freedom comes with nine characters, three scenario books, and two map locations.  Will you take the role of the stalwart heroes or the dastardly villains? The choice is yours in  Sentinel Tactics !

Additional Bonus! Every copy of Sentinel Tactics: The Flame of Freedom ordered from this webstore comes with a pack of fifteen promo cards: one additional Power Card for each character from the Flame of Freedom set AND the Uprising expansion!
